profile_text.body:
Poolside is a foundation model company that describes its mission as driving abundance for humanity by creating artificial general intelligence. The company positions itself around bringing intelligence to "everywhere work gets done," and works in the open on research, engineering, and ideas in this space.

The company has released two models in the Laguna family: Laguna M.1 and Laguna XS.2. These models are accompanied by a runtime designed to train and operate agents, with both available through product experiences currently in research preview. Poolside has also published research on NVIDIA's NVLink C2C technology, demonstrating a 6–13% throughput improvement over selective activation checkpointing when offloading MLP activations to host memory during training.
